subject: Request: SSO claims snapshot + SCIM delta + RBAC mapping (proof pack)
messages:
From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@medicore.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 13:22:00 -0400
Subject: Request: SSO claims snapshot + SCIM delta + RBAC mapping (proof pack)

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for taking time on Friday. As part of our SIG intake we need a short proof pack to validate identity and provisioning controls before the procurement committee signs off. Can you help with the following items?

- A CSV of SAML/SSO assertions (claims) showing NameID and attribute sets for the last 90 days (anonymize PII where possible).
- SCIM delta logs for provisioning/deprovisioning between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-07 (audit-friendly format).
- An RBAC snapshot showing roles mapped to resource access (export from your console) and a short explanation of least-privilege enforcement (one paragraph).
- Any evidence of scheduled SCIM reconciliation / delta jobs and timestamps.

We are on a tight timeline — procurement wants these artifacts by Tue EOD (US Eastern) to include them in the SIG submission. If you need a narrow scope we can accept a sampling (e.g., exports for the top 10 accounts) but prefer full artifacts if available.

Also please include filenames and any checksums so we can match files when received.

Thanks,

Alice Wong
Senior Security Engineer
MediCore Health
alice.wong@medicore.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

[Attachment: SIG_Checklist_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@medicore.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: SSO claims snapshot + SCIM delta + RBAC mapping (proof pack)

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you asked for, with a couple of notes and a proposed delivery cadence:

1) SSO claims (CSV): we can export assertion logs covering 2026-03-01 to 2026-06-01. To protect subject PII we will hash NameIDs and strip email local-parts unless you confirm a need for full values.
2) SCIM delta: we can produce a delta export for 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-07. It will include operation (add/update/remove), timestamp, actor, and the resource id.
3) RBAC snapshot: we can export the role->permission matrix and include a short narrative on our least-privilege enforcement (policy and scheduled review cadence).
4) Reconciliation evidence: we'll include the scheduled job logs (job ids and last-run times) for the reconciliation window.

Proposed timeline: initial package (sampled full exports + manifest) by Tue 2026-06-09 17:00 ET; full exports by Fri 2026-06-11 if you need complete history. Let me know which you prefer.

Marissa, Hannah — looping you in to confirm the export locations and whether we should redact any fields beyond hashes. I will stage artifacts on a secured drive link and provide checksums.

Connor O'Brien
Security & Trust — Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

[Internal note: assign file generation to audit pipeline, request SCIM team run delta export, include sample rows in manifest.]

Quick update: audit pipeline ran a scoped job this morning to collect the requested artifacts. Items staged and expected filenames below. - scim_delta_20260601-20260607.jsonl (SHA256: b7c2...6fa)
- rbac_snapshot_20260601.xlsx
- reconciliation_jobs_2026-06-01_to_2026-06-07.log
- manifest_readme.txt (describes fields and redaction applied)

Notes on redaction: we hashed NameID values and replaced email local-parts with initials for sample delivery. If you need original email addresses for account matching we need an executed NDA addendum — please confirm.

Secure link (expires in 7 days): https://drive.redwood.com/s/secure/medicore-ssopack-20260609

Connor/Ian — please add these filenames to the evidence tracker (DOC-9382) and send checksums to Alice.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Manager, Trust Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
